offline_a.definitions:
T33 offline (a) — H1 self-filter on recorded T30 clouds: GT held-apple points left in the cloud while held.

Runs: T30 E3b ep1807 r1/r2, E3a ep1807 r1/r3 (server chunk <-> local planning row pairing from T30/p/<COND>_analysis.json).
H2 spheres (rebuilt with the tree's own functions, as AG3S.attach/_held_primitives does):
  geometry  = target_points (base) of the chunk BEFORE the first grasp.attach chunk (the manipulated geometry attach used),
  snapshot  = planning-row q of that chunk (T32 H2 "manipulated last seen" capture pose),
  trim_outliers(20 mm, 3) -> fit_surface_sphere(max_radius = 71.46/2 mm) -> covering_spheres(pad = 5 mm fine voxel, max_spheres 4),
  parent    = palm ee_left (URDF link pose of the constraint robot model, T24 tool build_robot); spheres stored in the palm frame.
Self-filter held spheres = covering radius + HELD_FILTER_SLIP_M (20 mm), inflation 0 (T32 H1 _prepare_frame_filter).
Cloud     = recorded raw_cloud (base) = fused cloud AFTER the T30 robot self-filter (no held spheres) — applying the held spheres
            on top of it is the H1 filter (robot spheres unchanged; sim frozen, capture q = planning-row q).
GT apple point = raw_cloud point whose mj_geomDistance to the apple geoms is <= 5 mm and smaller than to every other object
            body and to the left-finger geoms (candidates: within 90 mm of the GT apple centre).  Also reported at <= 10 mm.
Per chunk from the attach chunk to the detach chunk (or the last chunk); held_frame = False for the detach chunk itself
(safe_policy advances the latch before AG3S processes that request, so the detach frame is filtered WITHOUT held spheres).
in_hand = GT apple centre offset in the palm (ee_left) frame within 30 mm of its offset at the attach chunk (T32a h2_eval rule).
Sums (grasp->release windows) use held frames that are in_hand only; 'last3' = the last 3 in-hand held chunks (= the approach to
the release over the crate): n apple pts in raw_cloud, n left after H1 (slip 20 mm),
n left with query spheres only (slip 0), n non-apple pts removed by the held spheres (by nearest body).
Windows: grasp_t / place_t / release_t from T31diag d1 (same rules).

closed_loop_T33.definitions:
T33 closed-loop records: GT apple points left in the recorded raw_cloud (fused cloud after the server's self-filter incl. H1 held
spheres) for every held chunk (grasp.attach chunk .. chunk before detach). GT apple point rule as offline_a_held_points.py (<= 5 mm,
closer to apple than to any other body / left finger; candidates within 90 mm of the GT apple centre). in_hand = GT apple offset
in the palm... not recomputed here: 'apple_to_left_finger_mid_mm' (planning-row MuJoCo ee_finger_l1/l2 midpoint) is reported instead.

offline_e.definitions:
T33 offline (e) — G1: reference-chunk limit overshoot under URDF vs MJCF limits on recorded E3 runs (T28 + T30 E3a/E3b).

Per planning row (local frames.jsonl): Q = layout.chunk_to_trajectory(actions_reference)[:, :8] (the TO plan window, P=K=8),
q_now = planning-row qpos. Limits = trajopt.limits.build_limits(robot, layout, dt, LimitsConfig(source=...)) with position margin
0.02 rad (default), velocity/acceleration from URDF in both cases. Overshoot = trajopt.limits.limit_report (position / velocity /
acceleration, rad) + anchor (|Q[:,0]-q_now| - max_step, as sqp._limit_overshoot). A row 'overshoots' when any entry > 1e-9.
Per joint: which optimized joint carries the position overshoot (max over steps).

offline_d.definitions:
T33 offline (d) summary: hand gap distribution vs the 30 mm S3 reach, pre-grasp non-frozen chunks of T28+T30 E3 replays.
gap = min over hand spheres, anchor points of |p-c| - r, read BEFORE the frame's decision (what S3 reads).
pipe = AG3S._hand_for_grounding hand (constraint model at q_now, record finger joints); npz = recorded sphere_centres palm+finger rows.
hidden = manipulated state occluded or reason subset_kept_anchor (T32b classification); switches = decision mode 'switch'.

definitions.analyze:
T33 E3a/E3b analysis (copied from T30/p/analyze_e3_base.py; paths -> T33; T33 per-chunk fields added at the end:
to_metrics {returned, returned_index, projection, sqp_iterations, min_iterations, initial_eligible, initial_limit_overshoot},
held {grasp.attached.n_spheres, held record}, esdf held_free / tsdf_truncation, manipulated.hand, manipulated.split summary,
anchor.release_split). usage: analyze_e3.py COND

Per run: ../p2r/analyze_p2r.py:run_one (success / grasp_t / place_t / dz max / first close cmd / min opening / HOLD control steps /
comms HOLD / client timing / client refined-reference per chunk) — same definitions as Phase 2R (E0/E1/E2).
Per chunk (local planning row <-> server chunk_XXXXX.npz of that port's server_constraints, paired by exact match of the npz
refined_chunk with the local planning 'actions' AND reference_chunk with 'actions_reference', max abs <= 1e-5):
  gate            : local planning 'gate' (E3a: would_hold / would_hold_kinds; E3b: action / hold_kinds) and 'safe', 'ipc'
  executed        : all control rows of that chunk_seq executed
  manipulated     : server summary manipulated {id, state, admissibility.narrowest_extent_mm, reason}; its centroid (base) -> world
                    (MuJoCo base pose from the planning row qpos) -> |. - GT apple pos| mm and the nearest object centre
                    (apple/banana/orange/pear/crate)
  destination     : server summary destination {id, source} (None = not registered)
  exclusion       : server summary exclusion {source, active, grasp_active}; target_free ball radius / centre (esdf_stats.target_free.ball)
  finger_joints   : server summary finger_joints.opening_norm.left (value the models got, from request state) vs
                    local planning qpos[27]/0.045 (measured at that planning row) and |difference|
  worst row       : local planning max_violation_pair {link, tier, obstacle, clearance_m}; point_m (base) -> world ->
                    nearest GT object by mj_geomDistance (0.1 mm probe, P1-2 helper); inside_apple = signed distance to apple < 0
  refined-ref     : max over arm joints (16D 0-6, 8-14), executed rows 0-7 of |actions - actions_reference| (deg), local
  grasp latch     : server summary grasp {state, attach, detach, note}
  gripper         : refined chunk left gripper cmd rows 0-7 (min), applied_ctrl.gripper[0] of the chunk's control rows (min),
                    measured opening qpos[27]/0.045 over the chunk's control rows (min / last)
  server time     : local planning verdict.timing_ms {infer, ag3s, trajopt, total} + server profile_ms.esdf (ESDF build inside AG3S)
Grasp phase of a chunk: 'pre_grasp' = t_step < run grasp_t (GT apple dz >= 50 mm, planning rows) or no grasp;
'lifted' = t_step >= grasp_t and apple not yet in crate at that row; 'placed' = apple in crate at that row (analyze_e0 rule).

  would_hold chunk (E3a)  : gate.would_hold True — kinds from gate.would_hold_kinds

usage: analyze_e3_extra.py COND   -> p/<COND>_analysis_extra.json

Per chunk (paired server chunk):
  association / anchor : server summary manipulated.association.outcome (+shift/ratio) and manipulated.anchor
                         {source, kept_frames, geometry_source, since_frame}; decision reason = summary.admissibility.decision.reason
  switched             : manipulated.switched_from not None, and 'after_switch' = any earlier chunk of the run had it
  frozen               : summary.exclusion.grasp_active
  ball vs GT apple     : recorded esdf_stats.target_free.ball {centre_m (base), radius_mm, z_min_m}; GT apple = planning row

  stamps               : local 'observation' row with the same t_step: stamp_mode, camera_skew_sec, render_spread_sec
  verdict              : server summary verdict.classification {n_violating, n_allowed, n_unresolved, n_collision,
                         collision_by_why, allowed_by_tier} and the reason kinds
  violating rows       : recorded refined chunk re-evaluated with the T24 tool (as off1/f1_counterfactual.py, new rule =
                         working tree): every (step, query) with esdf clearance < 0 on the executed 8-step window; for rows of
                         authorized links (target_free mask) and others separately: link, tier (field.answer_tier with the mask),
                         clearance, GT nearest object (mj_geomDistance probe). Attached chunks: robot-sphere rows only
                         (held-object query points are not recorded) and flagged.
definitions.build:
Build the T30 <COND> fragment: T28-style condition/run summary (summarize_e3.py) + T30 extras from <COND>_analysis_extra.json.
usage: build_frag_e3.py COND [DUP_JSON]
Extras per run:
  association_counts   : server decision reason / association outcome counts (subset_kept_anchor, association_rejected, accepted)
  ball_vs_gt_apple     : per group (pre_grasp non-frozen / frozen / after_switch): chunks with a ball, GT apple centre inside, whole (+34 mm) inside
  violating_rows       : chunks with >= 1 refined-window esdf row < 0; authorized rows by (tier, GT nearest) and unauthorized by (link, GT nearest)
  stamps               : stamp_mode counts, camera_skew_sec max, render_spread_sec median / max
  hold_timeline        : (t, kinds) of every HOLD chunk (E3b) / would_hold chunk (E3a)
Q counts (per run and pooled):
  Q4 hold / would_hold kinds; comms HOLD (ipc timeout/stale/error) ; n_time_budget_hit
  Q5 constraint spheres: from server log (122, finger 3.25 mm, palm 6.22 mm) — not per chunk
  Q6 n chunks whose worst row (local max_violation_pair) is inside the GT apple; n violating authorized rows whose GT nearest is apple
  Q7 pre-grasp chunks where manipulated nearest centre != apple (T28 definition) and where the ball does not contain the GT apple centre

t33_extra.definitions:
T33 per-run extras from p/<COND>_analysis.json (analyze_e3_base.py copy with T33 fields). usage: t33_extra.py COND -> p/<COND>_t33_extra.json
Per run:
  returned_counts          : server to.metrics.returned over paired chunks (initial / accepted / projection / best_unaccepted)
  projection               : chunks with returned == projection: t, projection record
  refined_minus_reference  : per chunk (t, deg = max over both arms, executed rows 0-7, local), plus max/median overall and in grasp->release
  hold_timeline            : E3b: chunks not fully executed, (t, kinds, latch); E3a: would_hold chunks (t, kinds)
  attach / detach t        : server grasp.attach / detach
  held                     : held record at the first attach (n spheres, radii, fit, snapshot_state)
  worst rows place window  : chunks with grasp_t <= t <= release_t (release = first control row t >= place_t with left gripper cmd >= 0.5,
                             D1 rule) — worst row link / tier / clearance / GT nearest body (and nearest excluding apple for held rows 'attached:*')
  initial_limit_overshoot  : chunks whose recorded initial_limit_overshoot has any entry > 1e-9 (G1 on the new server)
  hand / split             : n chunks manipulated.hand.occluded_by_hand True; split n_triggered / n_split counts; release split events

t33_extra.definitions:
T33 per-run extras from p/<COND>_analysis.json (analyze_e3_base.py copy with T33 fields). usage: t33_extra.py COND -> p/<COND>_t33_extra.json
Per run:
  returned_counts          : server to.metrics.returned over paired chunks (initial / accepted / projection / best_unaccepted)
  projection               : chunks with returned == projection: t, projection record
  refined_minus_reference  : per chunk (t, deg = max over both arms, executed rows 0-7, local), plus max/median overall and in grasp->release
  hold_timeline            : E3b: chunks not fully executed, (t, kinds, latch); E3a: would_hold chunks (t, kinds)
  attach / detach t        : server grasp.attach / detach
  held                     : held record at the first attach (n spheres, radii, fit, snapshot_state)
  worst rows place window  : chunks with grasp_t <= t <= release_t (release = first control row t >= place_t with left gripper cmd >= 0.5,
                             D1 rule) — worst row link / tier / clearance / GT nearest body (and nearest excluding apple for held rows 'attached:*')
  initial_limit_overshoot  : chunks whose recorded initial_limit_overshoot has any entry > 1e-9 (G1 on the new server)
  hand / split             : n chunks manipulated.hand.occluded_by_hand True; split n_triggered / n_split counts; release split events

held_at_attach.script: inline (recorded grasp.attached.held + planning-row GT apple / table top 0.82 m world)

D1_oscillation.definitions:
T33 copy of T31-diag d1_oscillation.py (same metric code). RUNS: E2 (T28, 6), T30 E3a/E3b (all runs with grasp and place),
T33 E3a/E3b (all runs with grasp and place). Output outputs/verify/T33/d1/d1_oscillation.json.
--- original ---
T31-diag D1 — oscillation metrics on the EXECUTED joint trajectory, grasp -> place window.

usage: PYTHONPATH=outputs/verify/T31diag/snap .venv-ag3s/bin/python d1_oscillation.py

Runs: E2 (T28/E2_rec, 6 runs), E3a ep1807 r1 r2 r3, E3b ep1807 r1 r2 (T30).  E3a r2 is extra (task names r1, r3).
grasp_t / place_t : analyze_e0 rules (T28/E0/analyze_e0.py) — grasp = first planning row apple dz >= 50 mm;
                    place = first planning t of the final uninterrupted apple-in-crate streak.
release_t         : first control row t >= place_t with applied_ctrl.gripper[0] >= 0.5 (left gripper opening cmd).
Windows           : W_transport = control rows with grasp_t <= t < place_t ; W_place = place_t <= t <= release_t ;
                    W_all = grasp_t <= t <= release_t.
Signal            : control rows 'qpos' of the left arm (MuJoCo qpos adr 20..26 = left_arm_0..6), dt = 1/15 s (manifest ctrl_hz 15),
                    and separately the commanded 'applied_ctrl.arm' left 7 (same metrics, 'cmd_*').
Metrics (per window):
  sign_reversals      : per joint, velocity v_k = (q_{k+1}-q_k)/dt; count of k where sign(v_k) differs from the sign of the last
                        v with |v| > deadband (deadband 0.02 rad/s); summed over the 7 left-arm joints. Also per second of window.
  jerk_rms            : sqrt(mean over joints x steps of ((q_{k+3}-3q_{k+2}+3q_{k+1}-q_k)/dt^3)^2)  rad/s^3
  fingertip path      : midpoint of MuJoCo bodies ee_finger_l1 / ee_finger_l2 (FK of control-row qpos), world frame.
                        path_length_m, chord_m, path/chord ratio; turning: displacement vectors merged until >= 2 mm,
                        total turning angle (deg) between successive merged segments; mean curvature = total turning (rad) / path length (1/m);
                        n_turns_gt_90deg = merged-segment turns > 90 deg.
  hold                : control rows executed == False — intervals [t_first, t_last], resume t = t_last + 1.
  refined-reference   : planning rows in the window: max over left arm (16D cols 0-6) and executed rows 0-7 of |actions - actions_reference| deg,
                        and the same over both arms (cols 0-6, 8-14).

offline_b.script: outputs/verify/T33/off/bc/bc_rebuild.py (copy of T32a scratch h3_trace3.py, original kept as h3_trace3_orig.py)
offline_b.python: .venv-openpi-live (cuRobo, GPU; run between E3a and E3b, no other GPU job)
offline_b.definitions:
T33 offline (b)+(c) — copy of T32a scratch h3_trace3.py (h3_trace3_orig.py), extended with crate-wall measurements.
Variants (current tree CuroboFieldBuilder, fresh builder each): T32 (H1 held mask + H3 free, fine truncation 30 mm),
T32_nofree (same without H3 free), T32_trunc60 (T32 with fine_truncation_m None = the 60 mm TSDF for both tiers).
Fine window: centred on the RECORDED fine window of the paired server chunk (esdf_origin -> centre, target_centroid placement
with that single point) so the window matches the T30 server / T32 H4 real-chunk numbers.
Added per seq and variant: crate wall d<0 widths (0.5 mm samples, trilinear EsdfField.distance, same as T32 H4 band) on two
lines through the GT crate centre at z = centre + 4 mm: along base x (split at centre: lo = crate_wall_nx, hi = crate_wall_px)
and along base y (lo = crate_wall_ny, hi = crate_wall_py), for the fine and coarse tiers; fine occupied voxels classified
'crate'; slices (fine + coarse, xz through crate centre y and xy at crate centre z + 4 mm) saved to <out>.slices.npz
for the listed seqs.
--- original docstring ---
T32a H3 — after H1, do old traces of the held apple remain in the TSDF?

usage: MUJOCO_GL=osmesa PYTHONPATH=/mnt/dev/work /mnt/dev/work/.venv-openpi-live/bin/python h3_trace.py RUN N_SEQ OUT.json
(RUN e.g. E3b_ep1807_r1 of T30; seqs 1..N_SEQ).

Input: every planning seq of the recorded run re-rendered from its `qpos` (object poses included) with
`TransportScene.attach(...).capture(cam)` for the manifest cameras (the verifier's `T32/h4/render_real.py` recipe),
depth wire-quantised to mm. Robot pixels = GT segmentation of robot bodies (isolates the held-object effect from the
robot sphere filter). Attach = the recorded attach chunk; held geometry = the previous chunk's `target_points`
(T31-diag D3), fitted exactly like `AG3S._held_primitives` (trim → fit_surface_sphere(r ≤ 35.7 mm) → covering_spheres
pad 5 mm), snapshotted in the `ee_left` frame at the attach seq's q.

Variants (one fresh `CuroboFieldBuilder` each, server esdf config: voxel 20 / fine 5 / tsdf 5 mm, max_distance 0.4):
  A60  pre-T32: truncation 60 mm for both tiers (fine_truncation_m None), no held mask, seed exclusion at the snapshot
       points (voxel 10 mm, as `attach_from_target`) — the T31-diag configuration.
  A    = A60 with the H4-fix fine truncation (30 mm)
  B    T32: held spheres in the depth mask (H1) + seed exclusion = held sphere volume above the table (H1)
  C    = B without seed exclusion (is the exclusion still needed?)
Fine window: `FineWindowRequest(manipulated_points=[GT apple centre], placement="target_centroid")`.

Per seq ≥ attach: fine-layer occupied voxels (d ≤ voxel/2) classified by nearest GT collision geom within 30 mm
(T31-diag D4 `classify`): `no_gt_surface_30mm` = phantom (trail); `apple` = at the real apple.
Also: `held_min_mm` = min over held spheres of field(centre) − r (what the optimizer's held rows read, before margin);
`table_spot` = fine/coarse occupied voxels within 40 mm of the apple's seq-1 centre and ≥ 10 mm above the table top.
offline_b.note: H3 free here excludes points within 10 mm of GT crate box surfaces (tool reconstruction; the server excludes within 10 mm of its registered destination points); robot pixels by GT segmentation

closed_loop_records.definitions:
T33 (c) on the closed-loop records: crate wall d<0 widths in the RECORDED fields of every T33 E3a/E3b chunk whose fine window
covers the crate lines. Lines as bc_rebuild.py / T32 H4: through the GT crate centre (planning-row object pose -> base) at z = centre +
4 mm, along base x (lo = crate_wall_nx, hi = crate_wall_px) and base y (lo = ny, hi = py), +-150 mm, 0.5 mm, trilinear distance
of the recorded layer (T24 tool layer_from_arrays via fixed_input_ablation.build_field layers). Tiers: fine (esdf_distance), coarse,
free (target-free layer when recorded). Per half-line: [d<0 width lo, d<0 width hi, min distance lo (mm), min distance hi (mm)]; a half-line with 0 mm of d<0 is
counted as zero-width (its min distance says how close to 0 the field gets there).
usage: walls_recorded.py -> walls_recorded.json
